name: FileUpload
summary: Choosing files to send: a "Choose files" button, a drop area that also takes dragged files, and the list of files with each one's own progress, then done, or failed with Retry, and Remove. Not for picking a picture to crop (an image editor) or attaching files to a message (the composer's own button).
a11y: A `fieldset` named by the label, with the hint and the question's error as its description. The button opens the system chooser; dropping is an extra, never the only way. Each file is a list item with its name, size and state in words; its progress bar is named "Uploading {name}". Additions, completions and failures are said once through the polite announcer (failures assertively). Removing a file moves focus to the next file's Remove, else the previous one's, else Choose files.

props.name: label
props.description: What to upload, sentence case: "Receipts", "Profile picture".

props.name: hint
props.description: The types and limits, in words: "PDF or JPG, up to 10 MB each".

props.name: error
props.description: A problem with the whole question ("Upload at least one receipt"); a file's own problem goes on the file.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types the chooser offers, as for `input type="file"`: ".pdf,.jpg" or "image/*". Check them again on the server.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several files at once. Defaults to one.

props.name: dropzone
props.description: An area that also takes dragged files. Defaults to true; the button is always there.

props.name: files
props.description: The files chosen so far, with their state.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Called with the files chosen or dropped (only the first when not `multiple`); start their uploads and add them to `files`.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Removes a file (and cancels its upload).

props.name: status
props.description: `uploading` with its own `progress`, then `done`, or `failed` with the reason in `error`.

props.name: progress
props.description: The share sent, 0–100, from the bytes sent; leave it out until it is known.

props.name: error
props.description: Why it failed and what to do: "The file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller one."
